reference.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D tactical-RPG boss reference, a stolen quarry MECHA-DRILLER called the Grumbler. Generate ONE isolated industrial machine on genuine alpha transparency, landscape 1536x1024 preferred. Full machine from slightly above in a clear three-quarter side view, FRONT and DRILL pointing to screen-RIGHT, rear to left. Low, broad, squat silhouette: two continuous caterpillar track assemblies supporting a riveted charcoal-iron hull with worn rust-brown #8a4b3c armor panels, restrained ochre/brass #b28a44 edge bands, large raised cab near the rear with one narrow amber-gold windshield, single short exhaust chimney behind the cab, compact piston/hydraulic brackets supporting a huge conical steel drill at the front. Drill is about one-quarter of the total machine width, made of THREE chunky steel spiral turns tapering to a stout point; dark gray metal base and bone-gray lit planes, no chrome. One distinct track closest to viewer with three large dark wheels beneath rectangular linked tread plates; second farther track naturally partially hidden. An original prewar industrial crawler, hand-built and believable, chunky mechanical mass, no humanoid arms or legs, no weapons other than the mining drill, no cannon. The machine body, track mass, cab, amber slit, and right-facing drill must remain readable when reduced to 100 pixels wide. Full silhouette fits a width-to-height ratio of approximately 2:1. Clean uniform DARK BROWN #1b1410 ink outlines, flat cel shading, exactly one shadow tone per material; restrained broad scuff shapes only, no noisy texture, gradients, photorealism, soft lighting or 3D render. Consistent with original martial-arts fantasy characters in a hand-drawn animated world. No franchise likenesses, symbols, numbers or lettering. No human operators, ground, floor, cast shadow, smoke, fire, sparks, debris, scenery, labels, arrows, borders, watermark or backdrop. Keep a generous transparent border all around, every tread and the drill tip fully visible. Idle neutral pose, tracks level and firmly aligned to a horizontal ground-contact line, drill nearly horizontal.

sheet.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pose sheet for the SAME original GRUMBLER quarry drilling machine in reference 1. EXACTLY NINE separate complete machine cels in a regular 3x3 grid; square 2048x2048 preferred; genuine alpha transparency. All nine face screen-RIGHT, same slightly elevated three-quarter side camera, same machine scale, identical charcoal/rust/brass panels, rear amber slit cab, one chimney, two caterpillar track assemblies and THREE main near-side wheels, stout steel spiral drill. Do not redesign or mirror it. Reduce tiny scuff texture into a few broad cel-shaped marks. Clean dark-brown ink, flat base and one shadow per material, no gradients or 3D shading.
ROW 1, LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) idle A, tracks level, drill horizontal, amber viewport; (2) idle B, exactly the same neutral stance with only slight engine suspension compression and viewport a little dimmer; (3) walk A, machine rolling steadily, tread links advanced, wheels rotated, drill held fixed forward.
ROW 2, LEFT TO RIGHT: (4) walk B, opposite tread-link/wheel rotation phase, hull level, all parts same scale; (5) cast wind-up, hydraulic drill cradle retracts a little and tilts upward slightly, hull weight rocks subtly backward, tracks stay on ground; (6) cast release, drill cradle pushes forward and angles its tip slightly downward for a heavy shove, stout piston extends only modestly, no extra parts, tracks stay planted.
ROW 3, LEFT TO RIGHT: (7) cast recover, drill returning to neutral as the hull settles; (8) hit, hull recoils backward on suspension, one visible small dent on front armor, drill stays attached, tracks grounded; (9) KO, same machine powered down, cab amber light OFF, suspension slumps and drill nose droops toward ground, mechanically intact, no explosion or detached parts.
No flames, smoke, sparks, dust, rubble, beam, water, operator, characters, floor, ground shadows, backgrounds, letters, numbering, labels, guides, borders or watermark. Every machine entirely contained within its own cell with wide transparent gutters. No component crosses a cell boundary; every drill tip and all treads fully visible. The nine drawings must keep the SAME hull length, cab proportions, track width, and attachments; only the modest mechanical pose changes. This is a small game sprite sheet, not nine different vehicle concepts. The generated alpha is important; no black/white or checkerboard background.
sheet.reason: Insufficient gutters, clipped left track ends

spacingCorrection.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the SPACING of this 3x3 Grumbler pose sheet. Preserve the same nine designs, machine structure, colors, order and mechanical poses. Re-render every machine SMALLER, at about 70 percent of its present width and height, CENTERED within its own grid cell. There must be a very wide transparent gap between all neighboring machines: each machine occupies no more than 70 percent of the cell width, leaving at least 15 percent empty on each side. Give the entire sheet a generous empty outer border too. The current sheet clips the leftmost tracks and crowds drill tips into adjacent cells; restore complete rounded track ends and full drill tips on ALL machines. No machine may touch the outer border or any other machine. EXACTLY nine fully visible cels, still three rows by three columns, all face right, same slightly elevated camera and exact reference identity. Top row idle A / idle B / tread walk A. Middle row tread walk B / drill raised windup / drill lowered release. Bottom row recover / recoil hit / powered-down KO with dark cab and drooping drill. No shadow, no ground, no extra marks, no new parts, no labels, no borders. Preserve genuine transparent alpha; no baked black/white/checkerboard background. The blank transparent margins are essential, even though the machines look smaller in this source sheet.

portrait.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Square 512x512 UI portrait/icon of the SAME original Grumbler quarry crawler in the supplied reference. Preserve the rust-brown riveted armor, charcoal iron, dull brass edge bands, one narrow amber cab windshield, one short exhaust chimney, caterpillar tracks and conical steel drill pointing to screen-RIGHT. Composition: a strong close three-quarter crop of the cab and front hydraulic drill assembly, with the amber windshield at the upper-left third and the stout steel drill at the lower-right, so the two features remain recognizable inside a circular portrait crop. No human face or operator. Retain chunky hand-drawn dark-brown ink and flat cel shading; use one shadow tone per material, simplify tiny scuffs and rivets for a small UI icon. Flat parchment background exactly #f4e9d8. No background scene, gradient, smoke, glow, sparks, shadow, lettering, border, watermark or symbols.
